note: Hand-written by sujitn on 2026-08-07 to exercise the Judge seam (EVAL-3, ADR-0061 decision 3). This is NOT the labelled corpus decision 4 names — that is EVAL-2's unmatched-record list plus LongMemEval's own 500 references, and neither has landed. Ten rows cannot support a published agreement rate, and ADR-0039 decision 14 already refused to let four hand-written scenarios be described as a benchmark score. What it is good for: the rows are chosen so the lexical rubric and a model judge must disagree, which is the comparison ADR-0053 option 9 asked to be able to make. The rubric is expected to score around 0.4 here by construction; that number is a property of this set, not of the rubric.

pairs.name: paraphrase-duration
pairs.question: How long did the kitchen renovation take?
pairs.candidate: Going by your messages it ran about 21 days.
pairs.note: the rubric shares no token with its own reference and calls this wrong

pairs.name: numeral-form
pairs.question: How many espresso machines did I end up buying for the office?
pairs.candidate: You bought three espresso machines in the end.
pairs.note: `3` and `three` are different tokens to the rubric

pairs.name: different-unit
pairs.question: How long is the Thursday design review?

pairs.name: negation
pairs.question: When did my lease end?
pairs.candidate: Definitely not March — you moved out in June.
pairs.note: containment cannot see a negation, so the rubric accepts a contradiction

pairs.name: wrong-entity
pairs.question: Who approved the conference expense?
pairs.note: the reference appears in the candidate while naming someone else as the answer

pairs.name: exact-restated
pairs.question: Which standing desk did I settle on?
pairs.candidate: You settled on the standing desk from Fully.
pairs.note: both judges should agree; the set needs rows that separate nothing

pairs.name: extra-detail
pairs.question: When did I switch to the payments team?
pairs.candidate: June 2025, right after the reorg you mentioned.
pairs.note: extra correct context is not a wrong answer, and containment runs one way

pairs.name: abstention-correct
pairs.question: What did I decide about the Berlin office lease?
pairs.candidate: I don't have anything in your history about a Berlin office lease.
pairs.note: EVAL-1 decision 4's axis with an external corpus behind it: declining is the right answer here

pairs.name: abstention-invented
pairs.question: What did I decide about the Berlin office lease?
pairs.candidate: You decided to sign it on the 14th of April.
pairs.note: a memory system that invents context is worse than one that stays quiet (seed §4.4, EVAL-1 decision 4)

pairs.name: declines-when-it-should-answer
pairs.question: Which recurring meeting did I ask to move?
pairs.candidate: I'm not sure which meeting you mean.
pairs.note: both judges should agree; a non-answer is not a correct answer
